seoTitle: Change Leverage on TradingView Paper Trading
metaDescription: Learn how to reset your TradingView paper trading account and adjust leverage settings to practice trades with your preferred risk level.
intro: Adjusting leverage on TradingView's paper trading account lets you simulate different risk levels safely before trading live. This guide covers resetting your paper account and customizing your leverage settings to match your trading goals.

steps.heading: Open the paper trading section
steps.body: Navigate to the paper trading option on TradingView, which lets you simulate trades without financial risk.

steps.heading: Access account settings
steps.body: Find the icon under the paper trading panel that opens your account management settings.

steps.heading: Reset your account
steps.body: Reset the account to clear existing trades and configurations, giving you a fresh starting point.

steps.heading: Customize your leverage
steps.body: Adjust the leverage setting to control how large a position you can take relative to your account balance.

steps.heading: Align leverage with your goals
steps.body: Choose a leverage level that matches your risk tolerance and the kind of strategy you're testing.

steps.heading: Confirm the changes
steps.body: Click reset again to finalize your new leverage settings and refresh the paper trading account.

faq.question: Can I change leverage on TradingView's paper trading account?
faq.answer: Yes, you can adjust leverage settings after resetting your paper trading account.

faq.question: Why do I need to reset my account to change leverage?
faq.answer: Resetting clears existing trades and configurations, giving you a clean slate to apply new leverage settings.

faq.question: Is paper trading leverage the same as live trading leverage?
faq.answer: Paper trading leverage simulates real conditions, but actual leverage limits and terms depend on your live broker when trading for real.

faq.question: Can beginners use this feature safely?
faq.answer: Yes, since paper trading involves no real money, it's a safe way for beginners to experiment with different leverage settings.

faq.question: Where do I find the leverage option?
faq.answer: It's located within the paper trading account settings, accessible through the icon under the trading panel.
